description: MADxFLOW — the mutual-audit treaty between two verification desks: FlowExecutor (the Desk, ERC-8004 Base 1133756) and Mad Check (the angry auditor, ERC-8004 Base 1224530 / Robinhood 26409). Each desk grades the other's claims from source and prints the verdict either way. Work flows both ways and tolls book both ways: 1 cent per graded task, 1 cent per witness anchor, priced on the treaty book at the floor F = B / S from Mad Check's daily reserve print (B = graded collateral backing, S = 1,000,000,000 RCPT). The net settles in twin RCPT on Robinhood Chain (4663). Nobody pays to pass — a grade is never for sale at any price.
name: MADxFLOW
